incidents.place: Karunapuram, Kallakurichi
incidents.what_happened: Residents of Karunapuram colony who drank illicit 'packet arrack' mixed with methanol fell ill with stomach pain and eye irritation; deaths kept rising over a week as patients died in hospitals in Kallakurichi, Puducherry, Villupuram and Salem.
incidents.cause: illicit arrack laced with methanol
incidents.quote: CHENNAI: The death toll in the hooch tragedy in Tamil Nadu's Kallakurichi district rose to 61 on Wednesday.

incidents.place: Botad and Ahmedabad districts (Rojid village area)
incidents.what_happened: Spurious liquor sold in a dry state killed dozens in adjoining Botad and Ahmedabad districts; 51 people were hospitalised and lab tests found methanol in the mix.
incidents.cause: spurious liquor containing methanol sold by bootleggers
incidents.quote: At least 10 more people have died in India’s western state of Gujarat after having drunk spurious liquor, taking the toll in the incident to 38, state officials said.

incidents.place: Mashrak and Isuapur areas, Saran (Chhapra)
incidents.what_happened: Villagers who drank country-made liquor at a local joint in dry Bihar fell ill from Tuesday morning; toll reached 26 by Thursday (district later confirmed 38, unofficial counts higher).
incidents.cause: spurious country-made liquor
incidents.quote: The toll in the spurious liquor tragedy in Bihar’s Saran increased to 26 on Thursday, PTI reported, citing District Magistrate Rajesh Meena.

incidents.place: Five villages of Majitha block, Amritsar
incidents.what_happened: Spurious liquor made with methanol bought online killed labourers in Bhangwan and other villages of Majitha block; toll reached 27 within days. DSP and SHO suspended.
incidents.cause: illicit liquor made with methanol procured online
incidents.quote: The death toll in the hooch tragedy in Amritsar rose to 27, with four more people dying in the Majitha area in the past 24 hours, officials said on Thursday.

incidents.place: Vang Vieng, Vientiane province
incidents.what_happened: Young foreign backpackers who went out for drinks in the riverside tourist town fell ill from methanol-laced alcohol; six died (two Australians, a Briton, two Danes, an American), some after transfer to Thai hospitals.
incidents.cause: alcohol laced with methanol served to tourists
incidents.quote: A British woman, two young Danish women and an American man have also died, and several more people are reported to be sick, after going out for drinks last week in the riverside town of Vang Vieng, which has for years been a laid-back stop for young Western travelers.

incidents.place: Ekkiyarkuppam (Marakkanam), Villupuram and Madhuranthagam, Chengalpattu
incidents.what_happened: People in two districts died after drinking spurious liquor; six from Ekkiyarkuppam fishing village died on one day and others in Madhuranthagam. Toll later rose to about 20; police said methanol was used.
incidents.cause: spurious liquor (methanol)
incidents.quote: Ten persons died after consuming spurious liquor in Tamil Nadu’s Villupuram and Chengalpattu districts, ANI reported on Sunday.

incidents.place: Maghar and Auriya panchayats, Siwan; Ibrahimpur, Saran
incidents.what_happened: Spurious liquor killed 28 in Siwan and 7 in Saran, plus 2 in Gopalganj, across the Saran police range.
incidents.cause: spurious liquor
incidents.quote: Twenty-eight people died in Maghar and Auriya panchayats in the Siwan district, while seven people died in Ibrahimpur in the Mashrakh police station area of Saran district after allegedly consuming spurious liquor.

incidents.place: Turkauliya, Harsiddhi, Sugauli, Raghunathpur and Paharpur areas, Motihari, East Champaran
incidents.what_happened: Suspected hooch deaths first reported on April 15 across several police station areas of Motihari; toll reached 27 and five SHOs were suspended.
incidents.cause: spurious liquor
incidents.quote: Motihari/Patna: The death toll in a suspected hooch tragedy in Bihar’s East Champaran district rose to 27 on Tuesday with one more person losing his life after consuming the spurious liquor in Motihari, police said.

incidents.place: Villages of Dirba block and Sunam area, Sangrur
incidents.what_happened: Spurious liquor killed people across several Sangrur villages over four days; more than 20 hospitalised; police formed an SIT.
incidents.cause: spurious liquor (methanol reported)
incidents.quote: In Punjab, the death toll due to consumption of alleged spurious liquor in several villages of Sangrur district rose to twenty one while more than twenty persons are in hospitals, among them some are stated to be critical.

incidents.place: Yamunanagar and Ambala districts
incidents.what_happened: Spurious liquor sold at a vend under a 'Malta' brand killed 16 in Yamunanagar and 2 in Ambala; a later viscera report found methanol.
incidents.cause: spurious liquor (methanol) from illegal factory
incidents.quote: With the death of six more people, the death toll in a suspected case of poisoning due to the consumption of spurious liquor has jumped to 18 in Haryana, officials said on Saturday.

incidents.place: East Champaran district
incidents.what_happened: Five people died after drinking spurious liquor in East Champaran; first death on Thursday; twelve arrested.
incidents.cause: spurious liquor
incidents.quote: Four people died after consuming spurious liquor in Bihar’s East Champaran district, taking the death toll to five, officials said on Friday.

incidents.place: Chhoti Pahari locality, Sohsarai police station area, Nalanda
incidents.what_happened: Construction labourers drank spurious liquor together on a Friday night and fell sick after reaching home; eleven died. SHO suspended.
incidents.cause: spurious liquor
incidents.quote: Eleven people have died due to consumption of spurious liquor in Nalanda district of Bihar.

incidents.place: Kuwait (multiple governorates)
incidents.what_happened: Illegally made alcohol contaminated with methanol poisoned 160 people, mostly Asian migrant workers (Indian embassy said about 40 Indians hospitalised); 23 died and 21 were blinded or had impaired vision.
incidents.cause: illicitly brewed alcohol contaminated with methanol
incidents.quote: The Kuwaiti Health Ministry said 160 people, most of them from Asia, had suffered methanol poisoning since Saturday.

incidents.place: Nauraja, Patan and Gugra Kurd villages, Banda tehsil, Sagar
incidents.what_happened: Villagers began shivering half an hour after drinking hooch; eleven died and about 35 were hospitalised. Post-mortems indicated methyl alcohol; excise officials suspended.
incidents.cause: hooch containing methyl alcohol
incidents.quote: ELEVEN people died after consuming hooch (spurious liquor) in the village of Nauraja, Patan and Gugra Kurd of Banda tehsil, Sagar.

incidents.place: Phugewadi, Pimpri Chinchwad and Pandhare Mala, Hadapsar, Pune
incidents.what_happened: Methanol-laced liquor supplied by a bootlegger killed men in Phugewadi (10) and Hadapsar (4); eight arrested.
incidents.cause: methanol-laced illicit liquor
incidents.quote: Ten persons died in the Phugewadi area of Pimpri Chinchwad, while four others from the Pandhare Mala area in Pune’s Hadapsar succumbed after consuming suspected spurious liquor.

incidents.place: Maior Roma Resort, Vagator, Anjuna, North Goa
incidents.what_happened: An allegedly drunk SUV driver from Pune drove 50-60 metres into a resort compound late at night and struck a local woman at the reception, killing her; residents said drunk tourist driving at night makes the Anjuna-Vagator area unsafe.
incidents.cause: drunk tourist driver lost control inside resort premises
incidents.quote: Kurup, a resident of Pune in Maharashtra, who was allegedly drunk, is thought to have come to pick up a friend when in a drunken stupor he drove 50 to 60 metres inside the area of Maior Roma Resort and struck the woman.

incidents.place: Old Mandovi Bridge, Panaji
incidents.what_happened: A drunk car driver hit three labourers filling potholes on the bridge at midnight; one was dragged 30 metres and died, two were critically injured.
incidents.cause: drunk driving at night into road-repair crew
incidents.quote: In a chilling replay of last year’s Banastarim accident, a midnight collision on the Old Mandovi Bridge claimed one life and left two others critically injured.

incidents.place: Arpora, Bardez, North Goa
incidents.what_happened: At about 3.30 am a speeding car driven by a Russian tourist hit three Indian tourists from Hyderabad and Pune as they opened their parked car's door outside a restaurant, killing all three, then plunged into a nullah.
incidents.cause: speeding car at night hit tourists boarding a roadside parked car
incidents.quote: Goa's tourism script this season continues to be smeared in red when, on Saturday, early morning at around 3.30, a 27-year-old Russian tourist's speeding car mowed down three Indian tourists to death.

incidents.place: Kalyani Nagar, Pune
incidents.what_happened: A 17-year-old allegedly drunk after drinking at a bar drove a Porsche at high speed in the early hours and knocked down two IT professionals on a motorbike, killing both. The bar and the father were booked.
incidents.cause: underage drunk driving, speeding luxury car at night
incidents.quote: The Porsche car allegedly driven by the 17-year-old, who the police claim was drunk at the time after consuming liquor at a bar, knocked down two motorbike riders in Kalyani Nagar area here in the early hours of Sunday, causing their death, as per officials.

incidents.place: Khlong Sam Wa and nearby districts, Bangkok
incidents.what_happened: Herbal liquor spiked with methyl alcohol sold at street stalls in eastern Bangkok poisoned 37 people; six died and seven were on ventilators. 18 stalls closed.
incidents.cause: bootleg herbal liquor mixed with methanol sold at street stalls
incidents.quote: The number of people killed from drinking herbal liquor spiked with a composition of methyl alcohol rose by two more to six on Wednesday morning, the Public Health Ministry said.

incidents.place: Toddy compounds in Kukatpally and KPHB areas, Hyderabad
incidents.what_happened: People who drank toddy at several shops on July 6-7 developed vomiting, diarrhoea and low blood pressure; nine died and nearly 60 fell ill. Chemical adulterants were suspected.
incidents.cause: chemically adulterated toddy
incidents.quote: The consumption of contaminated toddy has so far claimed nine lives and left nearly 60 others ill in Kukatpally area.

incidents.place: Bilodara and Bagdu villages near Nadiad, Kheda
incidents.what_happened: An 'Ayurvedic' syrup sold over the counter at a village grocery to nearly 50 people contained methanol; five died on November 28-29.
incidents.cause: herbal syrup laced with methanol sold as intoxicant in dry state
incidents.quote: An FIR (First Information Report) was registered at Nadiad rural police station on Friday evening on the charges of culpable homicide, poisoning, and forgery among others after five persons died in Bilodara and Bagdu villages on November 28 and 29.

incidents.place: Annie Besant Road near Atria Mall, Worli, Mumbai
incidents.what_happened: A BMW allegedly driven by a reportedly drunk young man after drinking at a Juhu bar rammed a fishing couple's two-wheeler from behind at about 5.30 am and dragged them about 100 metres; the woman died and her husband was injured. The driver fled.
incidents.cause: drunk driving at dawn, hit-and-run
incidents.quote: In another shocking case of a hit-and-run in Maharashtra, a fisherwoman was killed and her husband injured when a BMW car allegedly driven by a Shiv Sena leader’s son, who was reportedly drunk, rammed into their two-wheeler in Mumbai’s Worli early on Sunday and dragged the victims nearly for 100 metres on the car’s bonnet, police said.

incidents.place: Nedumbassery, near Kochi airport, Ernakulam
incidents.what_happened: At about 1.45 am a speeding Mini Cooper driven by a 19-year-old hit a scooter from behind, killing three young colleagues returning from a late-night tea break; police confirmed alcohol consumption.
incidents.cause: speeding drunk driver at night hit scooter from behind
incidents.quote: NEW DELHI: A 19-year-old man who allegedly drove a speeding Mini Cooper into a scooter, killing three young colleagues near Kochi airport, told angry residents that his father would handle the consequences, an eyewitness has claimed.

incidents.place: Thakre area, Prithvi Highway, Dhading
incidents.what_happened: Four Indian tourists from Uttar Pradesh returning to Kathmandu from Pokhara at night died with their driver when their car collided head-on with a bus.
incidents.cause: head-on collision with bus on highway at night
incidents.quote: Five people, including four Indian tourists, were killed after their car collided head-on with a bus in Nepal’s Dhading district, the police said on Monday.

incidents.place: Snack stall (cool bar), Cheruvathur, Kasaragod
incidents.what_happened: A 16-year-old girl died and 31 people were hospitalised after eating shawarma from a snack stall; the shop lacked a valid food safety licence and was sealed. Shigella was later found in the shop's well water.
incidents.cause: contaminated shawarma (Shigella) from unlicensed stall
incidents.quote: A 16-year-old girl died and 31 residents of Kerala’s Kasargod district were hospitalised after they ate shawarma at a snack stall, The New Indian Express reported.

incidents.place: Restaurant on Paramathi Road, Namakkal
incidents.what_happened: A 14-year-old girl died in her sleep after her family brought home shawarma and tandoori chicken from a restaurant; 43 people including 13 medical students fell ill with vomiting, diarrhoea and fever. Shawarma was temporarily banned in the district.
incidents.cause: suspected contaminated shawarma/chicken from restaurant
incidents.quote: COIMBATORE: A 14-year-old girl, who ate shawarma from a hotel on Paramathi Road in Namakkal, died on Monday.

incidents.place: Momo stall, Nandi Nagar, Banjara Hills, Hyderabad
incidents.what_happened: A woman died and 15-20 others suffered food poisoning after eating momos from a single street vendor selling at different spots; GHMC raided stalls and found some running without permission. Vendors arrested.
incidents.cause: contaminated street-food momos from unlicensed vendor
incidents.quote: A 33-year-old woman died and 15 others suffered food poisoning after consuming momos from a single vendor at different locations under Banjara Hills police station limits in Telangana's Hyderabad, said police.

incidents.place: Temple in Hoskote, Bengaluru Rural
incidents.what_happened: Devotees who ate prasad at a temple fell ill with upset stomach; a 65-year-old woman died and 135 people were hospitalised.
incidents.cause: suspected contaminated temple prasad
incidents.quote: A woman died and 135 people were hospitalised after consuming the prasad (offerings) at a temple in Bengaluru.

incidents.place: Abhlod village, Dahod
incidents.what_happened: Over 400 wedding guests fell ill within hours of a feast that reportedly included paneer curry and mango juice; health teams collected samples.
incidents.cause: suspected contaminated wedding catering in hot weather
incidents.quote: Over 400 people reportedly fell ill after consuming food at a wedding in Abhlod village of Gujarat’s Dahod district on April 21, triggering a major public health scare.

incidents.place: Bawadiya Noabad village, Ichhawar block, Sehore
incidents.what_happened: About 200 of 1,200 guests were hospitalised with vomiting and abdominal pain after a late-night wedding meal; locals blamed the raita. All discharged next day.
incidents.cause: suspected spoiled raita (curd) at wedding feast
incidents.quote: Around 200 persons were hospitalised due to food poisoning after consuming food at a marriage ceremony at Bawadiya Noabad village in Ichhawar block of Sehore district on the intervening night of Wednesday and Thursday.

incidents.place: Corporation school, Kavundampalayam, Coimbatore
incidents.what_happened: Around 43 students fell ill and were taken to hospital after a lizard was reportedly found in the midday meal.
incidents.cause: lizard found in school midday meal
incidents.quote: Around 43 students were taken to the hospital as they fell ill after a lizard was reportedly found in the midday meal served at a corporation school in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, on Tuesday, 10 March.

incidents.place: Varanandi High School, Ragimaruru village, Arakalgud taluk, Hassan
incidents.what_happened: More than 20 students developed stomach pain, vomiting and dizziness after a dead lizard was noticed on a plate during the midday meal.
incidents.cause: dead lizard in school midday meal
incidents.quote: More than 20 students from Varanandi High School in Ragimaruru village, Arakalgud taluk, Hassan district, fell ill after consuming their midday meal on Thursday, September 26.

incidents.place: Restaurant at Perinjanam on the Guruvayur-Kodungallur highway, near Kaipamangalam, Thrissur
incidents.what_happened: At least 170 people were hospitalised and a 56-year-old woman died after eating kuzhi mandi with mayonnaise from a 24x7 highway restaurant on a Saturday night; health officials probed the mayonnaise.
incidents.cause: suspected contaminated mayonnaise with kuzhi mandi
incidents.quote: A woman died and at least 170 people were hospitalised after having ‘Kuzhi Mandi’, a biryani-like Yemeni dish popular in Kerala, along with mayonnaise from a restaurant in Thrissur.

incidents.place: Roadside shawarma stall, Trombay/Mankhurd, Mumbai
incidents.what_happened: A 19-year-old who bought chicken shawarma from a roadside stall fell ill and died days later at KEM Hospital; several others were admitted. Two vendors were arrested for selling spoiled chicken.
incidents.cause: spoiled chicken shawarma from roadside stall
incidents.quote: Two vendors were arrested by police following the death of a teenager due to suspected of food poisoning after eating 'chicken shawarma' bought from their stall in Mumbai.

incidents.place: Unauthorised school hostel, T Kagepura village, Malavalli taluk, Mandya
incidents.what_happened: Hostel children given leftover food from a Holi feast (vegetable pulao and chutney) developed stomach pain; a 13-year-old boy died and 28 were hospitalised, seven critical. The hostel was unlicensed.
incidents.cause: leftover festival-feast food served at unlicensed hostel
incidents.quote: NEW DELHI: In a suspected case of food poisoning, a 13-year-old boy died, and 28 other inmates of an unauthorised hostel run by a private school here were admitted to the hospital on Sunday after complaining of stomach pain following the consumption of food prepared for Holi celebrations, police said.

incidents.place: SD Hall hostel, Maharaja Sayajirao University, Vadodara
incidents.what_happened: Of about 350 students who ate dinner at the hostel mess, more than 100 developed food poisoning symptoms and were taken to Gotri and Sayaji hospitals.
incidents.cause: suspected stale or contaminated hostel mess food
incidents.quote: Of the approximately 350 students who dined at the mess, more than 100 showed symptoms of foodborne infection and were immediately rushed to Gotri and Sayaji hospitals for treatment.

incidents.place: Women's hostel, Government Medical College, Thiruvananthapuram
incidents.what_happened: Nearly 90 MBBS students developed vomiting, diarrhoea and dizziness after a hostel dinner of butter chicken, fried rice and lime juice.
incidents.cause: suspected contaminated non-vegetarian dish at hostel
incidents.quote: Thiruvananthapuram: A butter chicken meal turned into a medical emergency for nearly 90 MBBS students of the Government Medical College , Thiruvananthapuram, who developed symptoms of food poisoning after dinner at the women’s hostel recently.

incidents.place: Banh mi eatery on Tran Quang Dieu Street, Long Khanh, Dong Nai
incidents.what_happened: A banh mi eatery sold 1,100 sandwiches in one afternoon; at least 560 buyers were hospitalised, 12 critical, and blood tests on critically ill children showed E. coli.
incidents.cause: contaminated banh mi (E. coli) from street eatery
incidents.quote: According to Long Khanh Town authorities, of those who have had banh mi at Bang eatery on April 30, as many as 560 have been hospitalized by Monday while there are several others with mild symptoms who have visited hospitals for check-ups and returned home.

incidents.place: Chicken rice eatery, Nha Trang, Khanh Hoa
incidents.what_happened: At least 222 people, tourists and locals, were hospitalised over three days in the beach city; at least 60 had eaten at one chicken rice eatery.
incidents.cause: suspected contaminated chicken rice at eatery
incidents.quote: Authorities recorded the first 60 people, including tourists and locals, suffering food poisoning on Wednesday night.

incidents.place: Banh mi stall, Vung Tau, Ba Ria-Vung Tau
incidents.what_happened: Hundreds of customers of a banh mi stall in the beach city fell ill with vomiting and diarrhoea; a 71-year-old man with heart conditions died of septic shock from gastrointestinal infection. Stall suspended.
incidents.cause: suspected contaminated banh mi from street stall
incidents.quote: A 71-year-old man from Vung Tau died after being hospitalized for vomiting and diarrhea following the consumption of banh mi from a local stall, where hundreds of other customers also fell ill.

incidents.place: Two banh mi shops of one chain, Ho Chi Minh City
incidents.what_happened: More than 230 people developed abdominal pain, vomiting, diarrhoea and fever after eating banh mi from two shops of the same chain; Salmonella suspected and shops sealed.
incidents.cause: suspected Salmonella in banh mi
incidents.quote: More than 230 people have been poisoned in Ho Chi Minh City due to a suspected Salmonella outbreak traced to banh mi from two shops under the same chain, which have since been sealed by authorities.

incidents.place: Koshtwadi village, Loha tehsil, Nanded
incidents.what_happened: Nearly 2,000 people from Koshtwadi and nearby villages fell ill after a meal served at a religious discourse at about 5 pm.
incidents.cause: contaminated food served at religious gathering
incidents.quote: Nearly 2,000 people suffered from food poisoning after consuming food at a religious event held at a village in Maharashtra’s Nanded district, an official said on Wednesday.

incidents.place: Hiyadatpur village, Amni panchayat, Mansi, Khagaria
incidents.what_happened: Many villagers developed symptoms on Monday night after prasad was distributed following a puja; more than 250 had eaten it and many were taken to Khagaria Sadar Hospital. Link not yet confirmed.
incidents.cause: suspected contaminated puja prasad
incidents.quote: The incident occurred in Hiyadatpur village, located in Amni Panchayat under the Mansi police station area.

incidents.place: Hotel at Mavelipuram, Kakkanad, Kochi
incidents.what_happened: A young man fell unconscious after eating shawarma ordered online from a Kakkanad hotel, was readmitted days later and died on October 25 on a ventilator; the municipality closed the restaurant and police booked its owner. Six more people later sought treatment after eating shawarma from the same area.
incidents.cause: suspected contaminated shawarma from hotel
incidents.quote: Kochi: A youth died here on Wednesday while undergoing treatment for suspected food poisoning.

incidents.place: Savala village, Visnagar taluka, Mehsana
incidents.what_happened: Over 1,200 guests at a wedding dinner fell ill with vomiting and diarrhoea and were taken to hospitals in Visnagar, Mehsana, Vadnagar, Unjha and Kheralu.
incidents.cause: contaminated wedding feast (suspected sweet dish)
incidents.quote: Over 1,200 people fell ill and hospitalised after they consumed food at the wedding of a local Congress leader’s son in Mehsana district of Gujarat, police said on Saturday.

incidents.place: Temple at Somthana village, Lonar, Buldhana
incidents.what_happened: Over 300 devotees from Somthana and Khaparkhed fell ill with stomach pain, nausea and vomiting after taking prasad at 10 pm on the last day of a week-long Harinam Saptah; many were treated outside the hospital with saline hung from ropes due to a bed shortage.
incidents.cause: suspected contaminated prasad (bhagar and amti)
incidents.quote: The incident took place on Tuesday night during the last day of ‘Harinam Saptah’, a week-long religious event, at Somthana village in Lonar, Buldhana District Collector Kiran Patil told a news agency.

incidents.place: Tribal Welfare Residential (Ashram) School, Wankidi, Kumaram Bheem Asifabad
incidents.what_happened: 64 students fell ill with stomach aches after a hostel dinner; one Class IX girl died at NIMS Hyderabad after 25 days of treatment.
incidents.cause: contaminated hostel dinner at government residential school
incidents.quote: She was among the 64 students who were affected by food poisoning in a government-run Gurukul hostel in Wankidi Mandal of Kumaram Bheem Asifabad district of Telangana.

incidents.place: Jahangirpuri, Mahendra Park, Samaypur, Bhalswa Dairy and nearby areas, north-west Delhi
incidents.what_happened: Around 200 people fell ill after eating food made with kuttu (buckwheat) flour during Navratri fasting; calls began early morning and all were stable.
incidents.cause: contaminated or spoiled kuttu flour sold for festival fasting
incidents.quote: Around 200 people reportedly fell ill after consuming “kuttu ka atta” (buckwheat flour) during Navratri fasting in north-west Delhi, the police said on Tuesday.

incidents.place: Shops across Dehradun
incidents.what_happened: Over 100 people fell ill with vomiting, dizziness and abdominal pain after eating food made from adulterated kuttu flour bought for Navratri; flour came from a Saharanpur mill and 22 shops were sealed.
incidents.cause: adulterated buckwheat flour
incidents.quote: Dehradun (Uttarakhand) [India], March 31 (ANI): Over 100 people fell ill allegedly after eating food made from "adulterated" Kuttu Atta (buckwheat flour) in Uttarakhand's Dehradun, prompting authorities to seal 22 shops, officials said on Monday.

incidents.place: Restaurant and cafeteria, Abu Dhabi
incidents.what_happened: A number of customers fell ill after eating grilled chicken dishes contaminated with salmonella; the outlet was shut for poor food safety protocols.
incidents.cause: salmonella in grilled chicken
incidents.quote: A restaurant in Abu Dhabi has been shut down after a number of customers fell ill from eating meals contaminated with salmonella.

incidents.place: Near Tham Khao Na Nai Luang Park, Phanom, Surat Thani
incidents.what_happened: Seven Russian tourists showed signs of poisoning after eating an unidentified wild fruit near a park on the Khao Sok route; one was critical.
incidents.cause: ate unidentified wild fruit
incidents.quote: The Surat Thani officials told the Phuket Express that the incident occurred this week in the vicinity of Tham Khao Na Nai Luang Park in Phanom.
incidents.spot: Tham Khao Na Nai Luang Park

incidents.place: Bhiwandi-Wada Road, Bhiwandi, Thane
incidents.what_happened: A motorcycle carrying three people skidded on a pothole-ridden stretch at about 4.30 am; a 17-year-old pillion rider died during treatment, prompting villagers to block the highway and demand an FIR against PWD officials.
incidents.cause: bike skidded on potholes, triple riding before dawn
incidents.quote: Thane: Over 200 villagers from Bhiwandi-Wada Road staged a protest and blocked the highway for nearly an hour on Wednesday after a 17-year-old boy died during treatment following a motorcycle accident caused by a pothole.

incidents.place: Bharangi River bridge, Mumbai-Nashik Highway, Shahapur, Thane
incidents.what_happened: A 31-year-old disaster-response rescuer on a motorcycle hit a deep pothole on a rain-soaked stretch, was thrown onto the road and hit the divider; he died at Shahapur hospital.
incidents.cause: deep pothole on monsoon-damaged highway
incidents.quote: Thane: A 31-year-old member of the Thane Disaster Response Force (TDRF), who had recently participated in the rescue operation during the Kohinoor building collapse in Bhiwandi, lost his life in a tragic road accident after his motorcycle allegedly struck a large pothole on the Mumbai-Nashik Highway in Shahapur on Monday morning.

incidents.place: Near Diva Anjur village, Mumbai-Nashik Highway, Bhiwandi (Narpoli police limits)
incidents.what_happened: Returning at night from a birthday at a Bhiwandi dhaba, a 20-year-old biker from Wadala hit a pothole and fell with his pillion; an unidentified truck ran over them and fled. The rider was declared dead at Sion Hospital.
incidents.cause: pothole fall followed by hit-and-run truck
incidents.quote: A 20-year-old biker from Wadala died, and the pillion rider was injured after falling into a pothole and being struck by an unidentified truck on the Mumbai-Nashik Highway.

incidents.place: Budigere Cross road, K.R. Puram, Bengaluru
incidents.what_happened: A 22-year-old student on a two-wheeler fell while trying to avoid a pothole on her way to college and was run over by a tipper lorry, which fled. Residents said the road is full of potholes and loose stones.
incidents.cause: swerved to avoid pothole, run over by tipper
incidents.quote: A 22-year-old female student was killed after coming under the wheels of a tipper lorry when she fell on the road while trying to avoid a pothole on Monday, in the limits of K.R. Puram traffic police station in Bengaluru.

incidents.place: Rajajinagar area, Bengaluru
incidents.what_happened: A woman riding pillion was gravely injured in a pothole-related crash and died the same evening; BBMP filled the potholes afterwards.
incidents.cause: pothole-related two-wheeler fall
incidents.quote: BENGALURU: A woman who has sustained grievous injuries in a pothole-related accident on Monday, died the same evening after failing to respond to treatment.

incidents.place: Samruddhi Mahamarg (Mumbai-Nagpur expressway), Sindkhed Raja, Buldhana
incidents.what_happened: A Nagpur-Pune private sleeper bus hit a pole, overturned and caught fire at about 1.30 am; 25 passengers including three children were burnt to death, the door side being blocked.
incidents.cause: overnight bus crash and fire on expressway (tyre burst / hit pole reported)
incidents.quote: Twenty-five persons, including three children, were charred to death when the bus they were travelling in caught fire on an expressway in Maharashtra’s Buldhana on Saturday, PTI reported.

incidents.place: Near Kottappuram Railway Overbridge, MG Road, Thrissur
incidents.what_happened: A 32-year-old scooter rider returning with his mother from Vadakkumnathan temple swerved to avoid a pothole at 7.45 am and fell under a bus, dying on the spot; his mother was seriously injured.
incidents.cause: swerved to avoid pothole, fell under bus
incidents.quote: Thrissur: A 32-year-old man died in a tragic road accident on Wednesday morning after he swerved his scooter to avoid a pothole and fell under a bus.

incidents.place: Borghat section, Mumbai-Pune Expressway, Khalapur, Raigad
incidents.what_happened: A Pune-Mumbai truck went out of control at about 5 pm on the ghat descent and rammed two trucks ahead; all three overturned and three occupants of the first truck died.
incidents.cause: truck out of control on ghat descent
incidents.quote: The driver, cleaner and another occupant of truck KA-56-2199 suffered grievous injuries and died on the spot.

incidents.place: Borghat descent, Mumbai-Pune Expressway, Raigad
incidents.what_happened: A container truck with failed brakes descending Borghat rammed 25 vehicles including cars and buses on a Saturday afternoon; a woman travelling with family in an SUV died and over 18 were injured.
incidents.cause: brake failure of container on ghat descent
incidents.quote: An accident on the Mumbai-Pune Expressway on Saturday afternoon claimed the life of a 55-year-old woman and left over 18 people injured after a container truck with failed brakes rammed into 25 vehicles while descending the Borghat section.

incidents.place: Near Raitoli village, Rishikesh-Badrinath highway, Rudraprayag
incidents.what_happened: A tempo traveller carrying 26 tourists from Delhi-NCR and nearby states to Chopta skidded off the hill road at about 11 am and fell about 250 m towards the Alaknanda; 14 died and 12 were injured.
incidents.cause: tempo traveller skidded off mountain highway into gorge
incidents.quote: Fourteen tourists were killed and 12 injured when a minibus skidded off the road and fell into the Alaknanda on the Badrinath national highway in Uttarakhand on Saturday, officials said.

incidents.place: Anbukhaireni, Prithvi Highway, Tanahun
incidents.what_happened: An Indian-registered tourist bus carrying pilgrims from Maharashtra on the Pokhara-Kathmandu route left the highway and plunged into the Marsyangdi river; 27 Indians died and 16 were injured.
incidents.cause: bus fell off highway into river (cause undetermined)
incidents.quote: At least 27 Indian nationals were killed and 16 others injured when a bus with an Indian registration number plunged into the Marsyangdi river at Anbukhaireni Rural Municipality in Tanahun district on Friday.

incidents.place: Badr-Medina highway near Mufrihat, Medina
incidents.what_happened: A bus carrying Umrah pilgrims, mostly from Hyderabad, from Mecca to Medina collided with a diesel tanker at about 1.30 am IST and caught fire; Hyderabad police put the toll at 45 with one survivor.
incidents.cause: night collision of pilgrim bus with diesel tanker, fire
incidents.quote: Citing preliminary information, Hyderabad Police Commissioner VC Sajjanar put the toll at 45, saying a total of 54 persons from the city had left for the pilgrimage recently.

incidents.place: Chinnatekuru village, Hyderabad-Bengaluru highway (NH44), Kurnool
incidents.what_happened: A Hyderabad-Bengaluru private sleeper bus hit a motorcycle in the early hours and burst into flames within minutes, trapping sleeping passengers; at least 19-20 died (early reports said 25). Some escaped by smashing windows.
incidents.cause: overnight sleeper bus hit motorcycle and caught fire
incidents.quote: A passenger bus has erupted in flames after a crash with a motorcycle, killing at least 25 people and injuring several others in southern India, police said.

incidents.place: Marchula, Almora (Pauri-Ramnagar route)
incidents.what_happened: An overloaded Pauri-Ramnagar bus with passengers standing skidded and fell into a deep gorge near Marchula at about 8 am; 36 died. Transport officers were suspended.
incidents.cause: overloaded bus skidded off hill road into gorge
incidents.quote: At least 36 people have died and several others were injured after a bus fell into a deep gorge in the north Indian state of Uttarakhand, officials and Indian media reported.

incidents.place: Assar, Batote-Doda-Kishtwar National Highway (NH 244), Doda
incidents.what_happened: An overloaded Kishtwar-Jammu passenger bus went out of control on a curve and plunged several hundred feet into a gorge; 38 died including 11 women and 18 were injured.
incidents.cause: overloaded, rashly driven bus lost control on curve
incidents.quote: Ramban, Nov 15: In a tragic road accident, 38 people, including 11 women, were killed and 18 others sustained injuries after an overloaded passenger bus skidded off the road in the Assar area on Batote-Doda-Kishtwar National Highway (NH 244) in Jammu province on Wednesday.

incidents.place: Near Mirjaguda, Hyderabad-Bijapur highway, Chevella, Ranga Reddy
incidents.what_happened: An overloaded, speeding gravel tipper hit a Tandur-Hyderabad government bus head-on at about 7 am; gravel spilled into the bus burying passengers. At least 19 died including a 41-day-old girl, 22 injured.
incidents.cause: overloaded speeding tipper head-on with bus on narrow highway
incidents.quote: At least 19 persons, including a 41-day-old girl child, were killed and 22 others injured when a gravel-laden tipper lorry collided head-on with a government bus in Ranga Reddy district of Telangana on Monday.

incidents.place: Near Thaiyat village, Jaisalmer-Jodhpur highway, Jaisalmer
incidents.what_happened: An air-conditioned sleeper bus with 57 aboard caught fire shortly after leaving Jaisalmer at about 3 pm, smoke rising from the rear; the door jammed and at least 20 died (toll later 22).
incidents.cause: sleeper bus fire (suspected electrical fault), door jammed
incidents.quote: At least 20 persons were killed and 15 injured after an air-conditioned sleeper bus travelling from Jaisalmer to Jodhpur in Rajasthan caught fire near the Thaiyat village on Tuesday, ANI reported.

incidents.place: Near Fisherman's Cove Restaurant, Candolim, North Goa
incidents.what_happened: An elderly British tourist couple walking were knocked down by a rent-a-car driven by a domestic tourist; the man died and his wife was injured.
incidents.cause: rent-a-car driven by tourist hit pedestrians
incidents.quote: An elderly British tourist died while his wife was injured after they were knocked down by a rent-a-car driven by a domestic tourist at Candolim.

incidents.place: Happy Bar junction, Assagao, North Goa
incidents.what_happened: A rented Thar carrying young tourists, allegedly driven rashly at night by a 19-year-old, hit a car at a junction, killing a 65-year-old tourist from Bhopal.
incidents.cause: rash driving of rented SUV by young tourists at night
incidents.quote: A 65-year-old tourist from Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, died after a rented Thar SUV carrying young tourists allegedly crashed into his car at a junction in Assagao, North Goa, on the night of 24 February 2026.

incidents.place: Kata-Sai Yuan road near Sam Ao Viewpoint, Karon, Phuket
incidents.what_happened: A motorcycle carrying two foreign tourists lost control on a winding hillside road at about 5 pm and hit an oncoming car; one tourist died, one injured.
incidents.cause: tourist lost control of motorcycle on winding hill road
incidents.quote: PHUKET — A foreign tourist was killed and another injured after a motorcycle lost control and crashed into an oncoming car on a winding hillside road in Phuket, police said.

incidents.place: Ha Giang Loop, Ha Giang province
incidents.what_happened: A British teenager on a motorbike tour of the Ha Giang Loop fell off mid-ride on rugged terrain; she was moved to Viet Duc hospital in Hanoi and died on 2 April.
incidents.cause: motorbike fall on mountain loop tour
incidents.quote: A teenager from Britain lost her life when her motorcycle crashed in northern Vietnam, relatives said.

incidents.place: North portal of Atal Tunnel, Manali-Lahaul road
incidents.what_happened: A tourist group from Rajasthan driving from Manali to Lahaul at about 10 pm overspeeded and crashed into an under-construction bridge where iron rods pierced the SUV; one died, three injured. Police urged tourists to avoid night travel in hills.
incidents.cause: overspeeding at night near tunnel exit, hit under-construction bridge
incidents.quote: According to police, the group was travelling from Manali towards Lahaul on Tuesday night when the accident occurred near the north portal of the Atal Tunnel at around 10 pm, reported PTI.

incidents.place: Sarjapur, Bengaluru
incidents.what_happened: During heavy rain, a couple on a two-wheeler slowed to dodge a pothole and were hit from behind by a mini-truck; the 56-year-old woman died on the spot and the driver fled.
incidents.cause: braked to dodge pothole in rain, rear-ended by mini-truck
incidents.quote: Bengaluru rains: Woman dies while attempting to dodge pothole
incidents.evidence: checked; quote is the page headline (body sentences name the victim)

incidents.place: Nadi Naka bridge, Bhiwandi, Thane
incidents.what_happened: A scooter slowed for potholes and skidded; a truck hit it from behind and the 65-year-old pillion rider was run over and died.
incidents.cause: scooter skidded on potholes, hit by truck
incidents.quote: A 65-year-old man who was riding pillion behind his 25-year-old daughter died on Sunday after the bike skidded due to the potholes on road and was mowed down by the incoming truck at Nadi Naka bridge in Bhiwandi.

incidents.place: Dhamangaon near pipeline area, Bhiwandi, Thane
incidents.what_happened: A 59-year-old biker returning from work at about 5.30 pm lost control on a pothole-ridden road and was crushed by a dumper whose driver fled; residents said it was the latest of several pothole crashes in Bhiwandi.
incidents.cause: lost control on potholes, run over by dumper
incidents.quote: Thane: A 59-year-old biker from Bhiwandi lost control on a pothole-ridden road and died after being crushed by a dumper on Monday evening.

incidents.place: Chalackal, Aluva-Perumbavoor road, Ernakulam
incidents.what_happened: An elderly man's bike fell into a deep pothole on a state road; he died of his injuries. Locals filled the pothole with concrete the next day.
incidents.cause: bike fell into deep pothole
incidents.quote: An elderly man succumbed to the injuries suffered after his bike fell into a deep pothole at Chalackal on the Aluva-Perumbavoor route.

incidents.place: Mumbai-Pune Expressway near Khopoli, Raigad
incidents.what_happened: A Swift car carrying seven people was crushed between a bus and a trailer near Khopoli; two women died and five were seriously injured.
incidents.cause: car sandwiched between bus and trailer on expressway
incidents.quote: A ln accident on the Mumbai-Pune Expressway near Khopoli claimed the lives of two women — a 17-year-old girl and a 30-year-old woman — after a Swift car was crushed between a bus and a trailer.

incidents.place: New tunnel near Adoshi, Mumbai-Pune Expressway, Khopoli, Raigad
incidents.what_happened: A Pune-Mumbai truck went out of control inside the new tunnel near Adoshi, hit another truck and the barrier and overturned; its driver was trapped and died.
incidents.cause: truck lost control inside tunnel
incidents.quote: A truck driver lost his life while another person suffered injuries after a truck crashed into another vehicle from behind and overturned on the Mumbai–Pune Expressway near Khopoli in Raigad district on Sunday evening.

incidents.place: Mumbai-Pune Expressway near Khopoli, Raigad
incidents.what_happened: In the early hours of Friday a Pune-Mumbai tempo collided with an unidentified vehicle near Khopoli; the driver and a passenger died on the spot.
incidents.cause: pre-dawn collision with unidentified vehicle
incidents.quote: In the early hours of Friday, a fatal accident occurred on the Yashwantrao Chavan Expressway (Pune-Mumbai Expressway), claiming the lives of two individuals on the spot.

incidents.place: Devarakolli, Madikeri-Mangaluru NH 275, Madikeri taluk, Kodagu
incidents.what_happened: Four young men from Gonikoppal returning from Ullal died when their car and a lorry collided head-on on the Kodagu-Dakshina Kannada border stretch of NH 275.
incidents.cause: head-on car-lorry collision on hill highway
incidents.quote: Kodagu: A tragic road accident near Devarakolli in Madikeri taluk of Kodagu district claimed the lives of four young men.

incidents.place: Arpora-Baga road, Arpora, North Goa
incidents.what_happened: Four young tourists from Pune riding two rented bikes from Arpora towards Baga in the early hours crashed; a 23-year-old from Uttar Pradesh died and his pillion was hurt.
incidents.cause: rented-bike crash in the early hours
incidents.quote: A holiday in Goa ended in tragedy when a youth from Allahabad in Uttar Pradesh died while another was injured in a road mishap at Arpora in the wee hours of Saturday.

incidents.place: Fernandes vaddo, Marna, Siolim, North Goa
incidents.what_happened: A speeding Thar SUV allegedly driven by a drunk driver rammed a scooter in the early hours, killing a 32-year-old local man on the spot and critically injuring his minor nephew; the Thar was allegedly given out for tourist self-drive use.
incidents.cause: drunk speeding SUV hit scooter before dawn
incidents.quote: A 32-year-old man from Siolim was killed on the spot and his minor nephew critically injured after a speeding Thar SUV, allegedly driven by a drunk driver, rammed into their two-wheeler at Fernandes vaddo in Marna, Siolim, in the early hours of Friday, triggering outrage among locals and reigniting concerns over reckless driving on Goa’s roads.

incidents.place: Mandovi Bridge, Panaji
incidents.what_happened: A tourist driving drunk hit a biker on the Mandovi bridge at about 5.20 pm; the rider was flung over the railing into the river and was feared drowned as his body could not be found. The driver was arrested for culpable homicide and drunk driving.
incidents.cause: drunk tourist car driver hit biker on bridge
incidents.quote: The impact of the collision was such that the rider who got flung from his bike bounced from the dashboard of the car and plunged down into the river.
incidents.evidence: checked; death presumed (body not yet found at time of report)

incidents.place: Gramphu area, Koksar-Rohtang road, Lahaul-Spiti
incidents.what_happened: A tempo traveller carrying 24 tourists skidded off the road in the evening and plunged into a gorge near Gramphu; a man and a woman died.
incidents.cause: tempo traveller skidded off high mountain road
incidents.quote: In a tragic road accident, a Tempo Traveller carrying 24 passengers skidded off the road and plunged into a gorge near the Gramphu area on the Koksar–Rohtang road in Lahaul-Spiti district.

incidents.place: Near South Portal of Atal Tunnel, Dhundhi, Kullu
incidents.what_happened: A tempo traveller with 20 occupants including children met with an accident near the Atal Tunnel south portal; a tourist from Maharashtra died and several were injured.
incidents.cause: tempo traveller accident on mountain approach road
incidents.quote: One tourist from Maharashtra died while a few others were injured as a tempo traveller with 20 occupants, including children, met with an accident near South Portal of Atal Tunnel in Dhundhi today.

incidents.place: Near Gorlathu village, highway in Chitradurga district
incidents.what_happened: A Bengaluru-Gokarna bus with 32 passengers collided with a lorry at about 3 am and caught fire; eight bus passengers and the lorry driver died.
incidents.cause: overnight bus-lorry collision followed by fire
incidents.quote: At least nine persons were killed as a bus caught fire after colliding with a lorry in Chitradurga, Karnataka on Thursday, IANS reported.

incidents.place: Turn beyond Dhulha Dev parking, route to Ratangarh Mata Temple, Datia
incidents.what_happened: An overloaded tractor-trolley carrying 20-22 devotees from Bhind district to Ratangarh Mata temple overturned at a turn; two women died and 17 pilgrims were injured.
incidents.cause: overloaded tractor-trolley carrying pilgrims overturned at turn
incidents.quote: Datia Latest News: A tragic road accident in Madhya Pradesh's Datia district claimed the lives of two women and left 17 pilgrims injured on Saturday.

incidents.place: Expressway cut, Delhi-Dehradun Expressway
incidents.what_happened: A car reversing at an expressway cut without lights was hit from behind by a speeding SUV and dragged about 300 m; four occupants died.
incidents.cause: reversing at expressway cut, hit by speeding SUV
incidents.quote: Fresh details have emerged in the fatal road accident on the Delhi-Dehradun Expressway that claimed four lives on Friday.
incidents.evidence: checked; exact state/district of the cut not stated in the quoted text

incidents.place: Kaithapuram/Baithapuram village, Choutuppal mandal, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri (Hyderabad-Vijayawada highway)
incidents.what_happened: A police SUV travelling Vijayawada to Hyderabad hit the divider while swerving to avoid a vehicle that braked suddenly; two DSPs died on the spot.
incidents.cause: sudden braking ahead, swerved into divider on highway
incidents.quote: The car hit the road divider while trying to avoid colliding with a vehicle going ahead of them when the latter's driver applied sudden brakes at Choutuppal near Hyderabad.
